gloss: new and old; the old and the new

definitions.gloss: new and old; the old and the new
definitions.explanation: A pair word referring to both new and old things, often implying comparison or transition between them.

examples.japanese: {新旧|しんきゅう}⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are both old and new ones.

examples.japanese: {新旧|しんきゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The old and new changed dramatically.

examples.japanese: {新旧|しんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対比|たいひ}→対比：12417_taihi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧。
examples.english: The contrast between new and old is interesting.

examples.japanese: {新旧|しんきゅう}⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦やってきた→やってくる：17013_yattekuru⟧。
examples.english: The time for the changing of the guard has come.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新旧|しんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいて→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧、⟦{歩|ある}いている→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦だけ→だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In this town, old and new buildings stand side by side, and just walking around you can feel the history.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{新|しん} (new) + ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧ (old)
A typical opposite-pair compound (⟦{対義語|たいぎご}→対義語：29399_taigigo⟧ compound)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新旧|しんきゅう}⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧: changing of old and new (handover)
- {新旧|しんきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対比|たいひ}→対比：12417_taihi⟧: contrast between old and new
- {新旧|しんきゅう}⟦{入|い}れ{替|か}え→入れ替え：21232_irekae⟧: replacing old with new

SIMILAR PAIR WORDS:
- ⟦{大小|だいしょう}→大小：05557_daishou⟧: large and small
- ⟦{長短|ちょうたん}→長短：05558_choutan⟧: long and short
- ⟦{善悪|ぜんあく}→善悪：05563_zenaku⟧: good and evil
